_meta.description: High-resolution micro-step funnels for business scenarios with real-world probabilities. Shows the brutal reality of each path from first impression to sustained income.

guru_course_funnel.name: YouTube Guru → Course → Results
guru_course_funnel.description: Someone watches a YouTube guru (Liam Ottley, Iman Gadzhi, Andrew Tate type), buys their course, tries to implement. The classic 'make money online' pipeline.
guru_course_funnel.entry_point: Sees a YouTube video promising income/lifestyle

stages.label: See video in feed/recommendations
stages.source: baseline — YouTube serves 500M+ hours/day

stages.label: Click to watch
stages.source: YouTube avg CTR 2-10%, median 4-5% — Creator Academy 2024

stages.label: Watch past 30 seconds
stages.source: Retention Rabbit 2025 — 35% drop in first 30s

stages.label: Watch past 1 minute
stages.source: Retention Rabbit 2025 — <45% retention regardless of video length

stages.label: Watch to CTA at end of video
stages.source: Retention Rabbit 2025 — only 16% reach final 10 seconds

stages.label: Click link in description
stages.source: YouTube description link CTR 2-5% of viewers — Tubefilter 2024

stages.label: Land on sales page (page loads)
stages.source: 8% fail to load or abandon before load — Google Web Vitals 2024

stages.label: Don't bounce from sales page
stages.source: Unbounce 2024 — avg landing page bounce rate 60.6%

stages.label: Scroll down to pricing section
stages.source: Hotjar 2024 — only 25% reach bottom of long-form sales pages

stages.label: Start checkout process
stages.source: Baymard Institute 2024 — 88% cart abandonment on info products

stages.label: Complete purchase ($997-2997)
stages.source: Checkout completion rate 45% after starting — Stripe 2024

stages.label: Open course on Day 1
stages.source: Teachfloor 2025 — 52% never open a purchased online course

stages.label: Complete Module 1
stages.source: Teachfloor 2025 — 70% drop after first module

stages.label: Complete 50% of course
stages.source: MIT/Harvard MOOC research — 85% don't reach halfway

stages.label: Complete entire course
stages.source: Teachfloor 2025 — 3-15% completion rate, avg 8%

stages.label: Actually attempt to implement teachings
stages.source: Estimated — most completers never execute. Google 7-11-4 Rule

stages.label: Do first real outreach/action
stages.source: Of those who attempt, 60% do at least one outreach — Skool community data

stages.label: Get first client or measurable result
stages.source: ~5% of implementers get a paying client — FTC complaints data on course creators

stages.label: Sustain results for 3+ months
stages.source: 70% of first-time freelancers/agency owners quit within 90 days — Upwork 2024

stages.label: Reach $10K/month consistently
stages.source: Only ~3% of course graduates reach advertised income levels — FTC 2023 income disclosure analysis

guru_course_funnel.reality_check: The guru's income comes from selling the course, not from the method taught. FTC found that <1% of buyers of 'make money' courses achieve the advertised results.

freelancing_skill.name: Learn Skill → Freelance → Get Clients
freelancing_skill.description: Person decides to learn a marketable skill (web dev, design, copywriting, video editing) and freelance on platforms like Upwork/Fiverr. The most common path to self-employment.
freelancing_skill.entry_point: Decides to freelance instead of (or alongside) a job

stages.label: Decide to freelance
stages.source: baseline — 64M US freelancers (Upwork 2024)

stages.label: Pick a specific skill to learn
stages.source: 30% stay in analysis paralysis and never commit — estimated from Skool/Reddit surveys

stages.label: Start actively learning the skill
stages.source: 35% buy course/resources but never start — Teachfloor 2025

stages.label: Study consistently for 30 days
stages.source: 75% abandon new skill within first month — Duolingo/Coursera retention data

stages.label: Reach basic competence (can do real work)
stages.source: Of those who persist 30 days, ~40% reach usable skill level — estimated

stages.label: Create portfolio with 3+ samples
stages.source: 50% skip portfolio and go straight to bidding — Upwork forum data

stages.label: Sign up on Upwork/Fiverr
stages.source: Low barrier — 90% who intend to freelance create at least one profile

stages.label: Complete profile properly (photo, bio, skills)
stages.source: 40% leave incomplete profiles — Upwork Best Practices 2024

stages.label: Submit first proposal/gig
stages.source: 30% create profile but never submit — Upwork 2024

stages.label: Submit 10+ proposals
stages.source: Most give up after 3-5 rejections — Freelancer subreddit analysis

stages.label: Get first positive response
stages.source: Upwork avg response rate 2-5% for new freelancers, need ~20 proposals — Upwork 2024

stages.label: Get first interview/call
stages.source: ~50% of responses lead to actual discussion — estimated

stages.label: Land first paid job
stages.source: Interview-to-hire ~40% for freelancers — Upwork data

stages.label: Complete first job successfully
stages.source: 85% completion rate on first jobs — Upwork Trust & Safety 2024

stages.label: Get 5-star review
stages.source: 70% of completed Upwork jobs get 5 stars — Upwork 2024

stages.label: Reach $500/month consistently
stages.source: Median Upwork freelancer earns $17/hr, need 30hrs/month — Upwork earnings report

stages.label: Reach $2K/month consistently
stages.source: Top 30% of active freelancers — Payoneer Freelancer Report 2024

stages.label: Reach $5K/month consistently
stages.source: Top 10% of freelancers — Payoneer 2024

stages.label: Go full-time freelance (quit day job)
stages.source: Only 12% of side-freelancers quit day job within 2 years — MBO Partners 2024

cumulative_end_to_end.decide_to_first_job: ~1.5% of those who decide to freelance land a first job

freelancing_skill.reality_check: Freelancing is a real path but brutally competitive. The median freelancer earns less than minimum wage when accounting for unbilled hours, admin, and dry spells.

ai_agency.name: AI Automation Agency (2025 Meta)
ai_agency.description: The 2024-2025 gold rush: watch AI agency content, join Skool community, buy accelerator program, learn no-code AI tools, try to sell to businesses. Popularized by Liam Ottley, Moritz Kremb, etc.
ai_agency.entry_point: Watches AI agency content on YouTube/TikTok

stages.label: See AI agency content in feed
stages.source: baseline — AI agency has 500K+ monthly searches

stages.label: Watch 5+ videos about AI agencies
stages.source: 35% of viewers go down the rabbit hole — estimated from YouTube watch patterns

stages.label: Join free Skool community
stages.source: ~280K members in top AI agency Skool groups — Skool.com public data

stages.label: Actually engage in community (post/comment)
stages.source: 88% lurkers in free Skool communities — Skool analytics estimates

stages.label: Complete free training/mini-course
stages.source: 30% of free community members complete free training — Skool creator data

stages.label: Buy paid accelerator ($5K-7K)
stages.source: ~1.2% free-to-paid conversion in Skool — Creator reports 2024

stages.label: Start learning AI tools (n8n, Make, Voiceflow)
stages.source: 75% of paid members start the curriculum — Teachfloor course engagement data

stages.label: Reach competence with 1+ tool
stages.source: 65% drop off before tool mastery — no-code community surveys

stages.label: Build first demo/prototype for a use case
stages.source: 50% of tool-competent members build something showable — estimated

stages.label: Attempt cold outreach to businesses
stages.source: 60% never do outreach — fear of rejection. Sales training surveys

stages.label: Send 100+ cold emails/DMs
stages.source: 75% quit outreach before 100 sends — Instantly.ai data on new users

stages.label: Get 5+ positive responses
stages.source: Cold email response rate 1-5% for AI services — Lemlist 2024

stages.label: Book 2+ discovery calls
stages.source: 40% of interested responses convert to calls — HubSpot 2024

stages.label: Close first paying client
stages.source: 25% close rate on discovery calls for new agencies — Close.com data

stages.label: Deliver first project successfully
stages.source: 40% fail to deliver — scope creep, skill gaps, client expectations. Gartner: 95% AI pilots fail

stages.label: Get testimonial/case study from first client
stages.source: 50% of satisfied clients provide testimonials — BrightLocal 2024

stages.label: Scale to 3 active clients
stages.source: 70% of single-client agencies never get a second client — freelancer data

stages.label: Reach $10K/month revenue
stages.source: At $3-5K/client, need 2-3 clients. Only 20% of 3-client agencies sustain — estimated

stages.label: Sustain $10K/month for 6+ months
stages.source: 70% churn within 6 months due to client loss and no pipeline — agency surveys

market_context.market_saturation: HIGH — estimated 50K+ people attempting AI agencies in 2025

ai_agency.reality_check: The AI agency model is real but massively oversaturated. The accelerator sellers make more from courses than agencies. Gartner says 95% of AI pilots fail even in enterprises with resources. A solo beginner selling AI to businesses is fighting uphill.

ecommerce_dropshipping.name: Dropshipping Store → Profit
ecommerce_dropshipping.description: Classic e-commerce dropshipping: find trending products on AliExpress/Alibaba, build a Shopify store, run Facebook/TikTok ads, try to profit on the margin. Popularized since 2017, still attempted by millions.
ecommerce_dropshipping.entry_point: Sees dropshipping success story (YouTube, TikTok, course ad)

stages.label: See dropshipping content/ad
stages.source: baseline

stages.label: Research products and niches (1+ week)
stages.source: 60% never move past consumption/research phase — Reddit r/dropship surveys

stages.label: Pick a specific niche and product
stages.source: 50% of researchers commit to a niche — estimated from Shopify onboarding data

stages.label: Find reliable supplier (AliExpress/CJ/Alibaba)
stages.source: Suppliers are easy to find, quality is the challenge — 80% find one

stages.label: Build Shopify store
stages.source: Shopify makes it easy — 70% of those who start complete a basic store

stages.label: Set up payment processing
stages.source: Stripe/Shopify Payments auto-setup for most countries

stages.label: Store looks professional enough to convert
stages.source: 70% of dropship stores look obviously amateur — Shopify design review data

stages.label: Create first Facebook/TikTok ad campaign
stages.source: 40% get stuck on ad creation/targeting — Meta Business Suite complexity

stages.label: Spend first $100 on ads
stages.source: 25% chicken out before spending real money — estimated

stages.label: Get first website visitor from ads
stages.source: If you pay, traffic comes — 95% get at least some clicks

stages.label: Get 100 unique visitors
stages.source: Depends on CPC — avg $0.50-2.00. $100 budget = 50-200 visitors

stages.label: Get first sale
stages.source: Avg dropship conversion rate 0.5-2%. Need 50-200 visitors for first sale — Shopify 2024

stages.label: First sale is actually profitable (after COGS + ads)
stages.source: 60% find their margins are negative after ad costs — avg dropship margin 15-20%, CPA often exceeds margin

stages.label: Scale ads to $500/month
stages.source: 65% stop after seeing negative or breakeven ROAS — Facebook Ads benchmarks

stages.label: Reach breakeven (revenue covers all costs)
stages.source: Only 10-20% of dropship stores ever break even — multiple industry reports

stages.label: Reach $1K profit/month
stages.source: Of breakeven stores, ~25% scale to $1K profit — Shopify merchant data

stages.label: Handle first return/chargeback/complaint
stages.source: Chargebacks and returns are near-universal in dropshipping — Shopify Trust & Safety

stages.label: Store still active after 90 days
stages.source: 85-90% of dropship stores fail within 120 days — Oberlo/DSers data

stages.label: Reach $5K profit/month
stages.source: ~10% of surviving stores scale to $5K/month — estimated from Shopify top merchant data

ecommerce_dropshipping.reality_check: Dropshipping has been the #1 'make money online' pitch since 2017. The math rarely works: if your product costs $15, sells for $35, and your CPA is $25+, you're making $0 or losing money. Winning products have short lifespans (weeks) before competition copies them.

content_creator.name: Content Creator → Monetization → Full-Time
content_creator.description: Person starts creating content (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, blog) with the goal of eventually making it a full-time income. The modern dream of 'being a creator.'

stages.label: Decide to start creating content
stages.source: baseline — 50M+ people globally identify as content creators (SignalFire 2024)

stages.label: Pick primary platform (YouTube, TikTok, IG, etc.)
stages.source: 20% stay platform-hopping and never commit — creator surveys

stages.label: Plan first video/post in detail
stages.source: 30% get stuck in planning and never create — estimated

stages.label: Actually create and finish first piece
stages.source: 50% of planners never finish their first piece — ConvertKit Creator Report 2024

stages.label: Publish first content publicly
stages.source: 15% create but never publish (fear of judgment) — estimated

stages.label: Get 0-50 views on first content
stages.source: Almost everyone gets some views, but very few — YouTube/TikTok algorithms

stages.label: Publish 10 pieces of content
stages.source: 80% quit before 10 posts — MrBeast: 'most creators quit after 3 videos'

stages.label: Publish 30 pieces (30-day consistency)
stages.source: 90% fail the 30-day consistency test — Buffer/Hootsuite creator data

stages.label: Reach 100 followers/subscribers
stages.source: First 100 is hardest — 50% of consistent creators reach it in 3 months

stages.label: Reach 1,000 followers/subscribers
stages.source: 90% of YT channels never reach 1K subs — Tubics 2024

stages.label: Reach 10,000 followers/subscribers
stages.source: Only ~10% of 1K channels reach 10K — Social Blade data

stages.label: Apply for platform monetization (YPP, etc.)
stages.source: Most eligible creators apply — YouTube 2024

stages.label: Get accepted into monetization program
stages.source: YouTube accepts ~70% of YPP applications — YouTube Creator Academy

stages.label: First ad revenue payment
stages.source: Most monetized creators eventually hit minimum payout threshold

stages.label: Reach $100/month from ads
stages.source: Median monetized YT channel earns <$100/month — Influencer Marketing Hub 2024

stages.label: Diversify revenue (sponsors, products, affiliate)
stages.source: 75% rely solely on ad revenue — ConvertKit Creator Economy Report

stages.label: Reach $1K/month total creator income
stages.source: Only 12% of full-time creators earn >$50K/year — ConvertKit 2024

stages.label: Reach $5K/month total creator income
stages.source: Top 5% of creators — Goldman Sachs Creator Economy Report 2024

stages.label: Full-time creator at $100K+/year
stages.source: Only 2% of creators earn $100K+ — SignalFire/Goldman Sachs 2024. Top 1% earns 90% of total creator revenue.

content_creator.reality_check: The creator economy is a power law: the top 1% earn 90% of all revenue. The median full-time creator earns $15K/year — below poverty line in most Western countries. 63% of creators report burnout. The survivorship bias in creator content is extreme.
sources: ConvertKit State of the Creator Economy 2024
